words.meaning: Sweet or musical; pleasant to hear
words.sentence1: The singer's mellifluous voice filled the autumn hall with warmth. (The singer's sweet voice filled the autumn hall with warmth.)
words.sentence2: We listened to the mellifluous sounds of laughter during the harvest feast. (We listened to the sweet sounds of laughter during the harvest feast.)

words.sentence1: La jovialidad de la gente hizo que la celebracion fuera inolvidable. (The jovialty of the people made the celebration unforgettable.)
words.sentence2: Se podia sentir la jovialidad en el aire mientras recogian los frutos. (You could feel the joyfulness in the air while they gathered the fruits.)

words.sentence1: Le village a accueilli la recolte avec une grande allegresse. (The village welcomed the harvest with great jubilation.)
words.sentence2: Il y avait de l'allegresse dans chaque regard ce jour-la. (There was cheerfulness in every look that day.)

words.sentence1: Der Frohsinn der Familie erhellte den dunklen Herbstabend. (The cheerfulness of the family brightened the dark autumn evening.)
words.sentence2: Sie feierten das Erntefest mit großem Frohsinn und Gesang. (They celebrated the harvest festival with great joyfulness and singing.)

words.sentence1: Noumin tachi wa utage de kanki ni michite ita. (The farmers were filled with great joy at the banquet.)
words.sentence2: Housaku no nureta daichi ni kanki no koe ga hibiita. (Voices of delight echoed across the wet earth of the abundant harvest.)

words.sentence1: C'era grande esultanza quando i campi diedero i loro frutti. (There was great exultation when the fields yielded their fruits.)
words.sentence2: La loro esultanza era contagiosa durante la festa del raccolto. (Their jubilation was contagious during the harvest festival.)

words.meaning: Joyful and happy, filled with delight
words.sentence1: Guomin zai shouhuo de jijiang xihuanyue de qingzhu. (The citizens joyfully celebrated the approaching harvest.)
words.sentence2: Tamen de lian shang dao chu shi xihuanyue de biaoqing. (Their faces were filled with joyful expressions everywhere.)

words.sentence1: Chusuui gippeumeuro maeumi hwanhuiro gadeuk chaetda. (The heart was filled with rapturous joy from the happiness of autumn harvest.)
words.sentence2: Nongbuui nunbichi hwanhuiro binnago isseotda. (The farmer's eyes were shining with ecstasy.)

words.sentence1: Pracheachon mean saboray ying klang knong pelเก็บ kat phle cheu. (The people had great joy during the fruit harvesting time.)
words.sentence2: Samleng nyum jomreang ban banhchenh saboray robos puokke. (The sound of laughter and singing expressed their gladness.)

words.sentence1: Daar was groot vreugde toe die oes uiteindelik ingesamel is. (There was great joy when the harvest was finally gathered.)
words.sentence2: Sy het haar vreugde gedeel met almal op die plaas. (She shared her delight with everyone on the farm.)
